parsed.explanation: No trans-specific crime, facility ban, border or detention exposure is documented, and same-sex conduct is lawful with sexual-orientation protections. Everyday risk therefore turns on outing consequences: gender identity has no anti-discrimination ground, no local marker process, and no documented trans-specific acceptance or violence, only a dated 2012 account that gay people live comfortably. Official Catholic/monarch hostility to rainbow families is real but dated and did not prevent marriage/adoption equality in 2025. With no active traveler-facing restriction but thin recourse for trans-specific discrimination, this sits moderately below working-protection jurisdictions, above bureaucratic-exposure regimes.

entry_documents.exposure: No documented border friction; local marker-change absence does not affect foreign-issued visitor documents.
entry_documents.protection: Visitor not affected by domestic marker practice per dossier.
entry_documents.interaction: Local document mismatch is resident-only; no documented refusal at entry.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: No documented trans-targeted stops, arrests, detention or custody placement.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Section 283 enforcement data not documented, so application uncertain.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: No law in force restricts sex-segregated facilities by gender identity.
federal_state_facilities.protection: Absence of facility restriction; no positive facilities protection documented.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: Absence follows from no GI legislation; no positive rule stated.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: Head of state 2016 remarks against rainbow families; Catholic Church state religion and archbishop opposed marriage equality.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: Penal/media bans cover sexual orientation, not gender identity/expression.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Hostile rhetoric did not block 2025 marriage/adoption equality; no trans-specific threat law documented.

minors_guardians.exposure: No documented visitor/minor restriction; 2016 'normal family' remarks concern resident family policy.
minors_guardians.protection: Marriage and joint adoption open regardless of gender/sexual orientation since Jan 2025.
minors_guardians.interaction: Resident family rights are climate signal only for travelling guardians.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: No documented trans-specific violence, harassment or police targeting; 2012 guide says gay people live comfortably, few organised enemies.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Everyday account is dated 2012, pre-Pride 2022, and gay-specific, not trans-specific.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: No anti-discrimination ground for gender identity/expression/sex characteristics; equal-opportunities mandate is sexual-orientation only.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Sexual-orientation harassment/incitement banned since 2016, s283 up to 2 years, but trans remedy not documented.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Thin formal recourse if trans discrimination occurs; enforcement of existing provisions unresolved.

anchor_checks.comparison: Lower: 0.85 has explicit GI equality law, chosen-name documents and audited remedies; here GI protection, marker recognition and trans remedies are absent, though no active exposure is documented.
Higher: 0.65 involves documented document-mismatch detention and questioning despite national protection; here no such encounter, facility ban or detention is documented.
Higher: 0.55 has routine secondary screening, hours-long interviews and discretionary refusal of entry; here no border screening exposure is documented and same-sex conduct is lawful.

parsed.synthesis: Combined regime is permissive law with thin trans recourse: lawful same-sex and sexual-orientation protections, unrestricted facilities, and no documented state targeting lower severity if outed, while absence of GI anti-discrimination protection, no local marker process, dated gay-specific social evidence, and historic official hostility prevent a higher score. Uncertainty is about undocumented everyday trans treatment, not a known traveler-facing exposure.
